output.answer_markdown: In its fiscal 2022 10-K, Nucor says EPD legislation has already caused it to incur additional costs, and that it has the potential to put domestic steel manufacturers at a disadvantage to foreign competitors. This applies unless standardized mechanisms are used to fully evaluate products made by foreign steel producers [5]. Nucor also lists emerging customer preferences for greater product transparency and less GHG-intensive materials as a risk that may put it at a competitive disadvantage or reduce demand for its products [5]. The federal government and numerous states are considering EPD requirements, and California has enacted the Buy Clean California Act and established Global Warming Potential benchmarks through EPDs for certain materials, including certain steel products [5].
